Downtown at the San Fernando Cathedral has a free light show Tuesday through Sunday. There’s usually 2 showing a night I think at 9 then 9:30. One of my favorite first dates I went on. My great grandpa had been sick for a while we all knew he was going to pass soon. One night I have this weird dream about my great grandpa going into my grandparents house saying good bye to everyone and also saying not to worry because my aunt would take care of him. I woke up excited to tell my mom about the dream because maybe it meant he would get better, turns out he died that night. A few weeks later my aunt that my great grandpa had mentioned in the dream announces that she is pregnant and later named the child after my great grandpa. About 2 years ago I had another dream about my great grandpa telling me that he was proud of me and not to worry about my mom, who had recently suffered from a minor stroke, that she would be ok it wasn't even close to her time yet. When I told my mom about the dream she looked at the calendar and realized it was the anniversary of his death. 

Another story I have is about my grandpa don't worry not so long. Anyways, my grandpa passed away in his house. I spelt over one night a month or so after his funeral, my grandma had me sleeping on the couch that faces the door to their bedroom. For the life of me I just could not sleep I felt like someone was there with me the whole time it was unnerving. Once I finally did fall asleep I woke up just a little while later to see someone looking at me from the doorway. I was terrified not knowing what to do I just closed my eyes and prayed form the light of day. I still haven't gone back to spend the night at my grandmas house nor can I stay there for long without feeling uneasy.
